name: Initial Margin Requirement 1
definition: Liability and assets that arise for a clearing member with respect to a central counterparty.

InitialMarginExposure.name: Initial Margin Exposure
InitialMarginExposure.definition: Liability a clearing member has to a central counterparty with respect to potential future exposures.

Credit.name: Credit
Credit.definition: Total value of any credits offsetable against initial margin requirements at the end of day. For example, net liquidating value of option positions, contingent variation margin, delivery credits.
